intent.summary: Make Rows telemetry best-effort: missing config or network failures no longer trigger unhandled fetch errors.
intent.whyNow: Reporting failures surfaced as user-visible console errors (Failed to fetch) and could disrupt popup flows; telemetry must be fail-open.

decisions.title: Error handling strategy for telemetry
decisions.rationale: Telemetry is non-critical; user extraction/export flows must never depend on it.

decisions.title: Behavior when Rows env vars are missing
decisions.rationale: Prevents invalid URLs like .../undefined/... and avoids noisy failures.

evidence.notes: Typecheck and build pass. With no Rows env vars configured, reporting becomes a no-op and does not emit unhandled promise rejections.

followUps: Optional: add lightweight debug logging behind a flag when reporting is skipped due to missing env vars.
